content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of SGLT2 inhibitors for patients diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease (CKD), provided their estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) is at least 20 mL/min/1.73 m². This recommendation is particularly emphasized for individuals who exhibit albuminuria, as these medications have been shown to effectively reduce cardiovascular risks in this patient population.
